statement: The paper reduces the ordered-radius, nontangent input-position cases to twelve cases, listing the four discriminant signs and the real count for each.

answer.text: The paper reduces the ordered-radius, nontangent input-position cases to twelve cases, listing the four discriminant signs and the real count for each.
answer.qualification: Twelve cases in Stoll’s nontangent, strictly ordered positive-radius regime; not a count of connected chambers in the full labelled parameter complement.

source.location: Case reduction original p.625 and twelve-row unnumbered table p.626
source.version: Original German journal article (1873), GDZ article scan; PDF page 1 is a digitization cover, original p.613 begins on PDF page 2.

scope: Three ordinary real input circles with strictly ordered positive radii and general centres, excluding mutual tangencies and the collinear-centre/zero-radius/straight-line special loci discussed separately.
notes: A classification by relative circle position and branch signs, not a claim that the full labelled parameter complement has exactly twelve connected chambers.
